title: Novel pyrazolone–thiophene Schiff base functionalized Fe3O4 nanocomposite: core–shell structure and multi-technique characterization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43120-43140
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07567J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marwa Abdel-Motaal, Lotfi Beji, Noura Kouki, Medhat Asem, Mohammed E. Abdelmageed
This work reports the synthesis and structural characterization of a new magnetic nanocomposite, Fe3O4@PyTh, created by forming a surface-functionalized magnetic nanocomposite with a pyrazolone–thiophene Schiff base (PyTh).
